title: Impasto Greyscale Flatwoven Rug
description: Impasto Greyscale Rug is inspired by the 17th century painting technique of applying thick layers of paint to a canvas to create visual texture and depth. Featuring varying hues of neutral grey, this monochromatic, abstract art-inspired rug is the perfect accent to set a stylish foundation in any room.
